tasks.name: 切换自动补全 taskjs 包裹
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/scheduled-tasks/scheduled-tasks.js');
    const on = mod.toggleAutoWrapTaskJs();
    window.toastr?.success('✅ 自动补全 taskjs 包裹: ' + (on ? 'ON（输入框无 <<taskjs>> 时自动包裹）' : 'OFF（按原样保存）'));
})();
<</taskjs>>
